cohort: The study included 60 full-term pregnant women.
finding: Abnormal amniotic fluid index (oligohydramnios and polyhydramnios) in term pregnancies was significantly associated with increased rates of cesarean delivery, fetal distress, and neonatal intensive care unit admissions.
mod_finding: Both oligohydramnios and polyhydramnios were significantly associated with increased rates of cesarean delivery.
